hash_algorithm: Git blob SHA-1: SHA1("blob " + canonical byte length + NUL + canonical bytes); saved model SHA-256 is supplemental
scope: All pinned repository source blobs preserved, plus only new visual-fidelity package/checkpoint/workflow/root-guide paths.

native_review_workspace.color_precision_limit: Native colors are compared with immediately imported Blender data; BYTE_COLOR quantization is not GLB float32 byte identity.

excluded: Generated standalone HTML rebuilt by CI
verification_limits: Hashes and GLB structure do not certify perfect appearance, missing anatomy, global intersections, rig deformation or gameplay.
